description: Insert a page number or section marker (Type > Insert Special Character > Markers): Current Page Number (usually on a parent page), Next or Previous Page Number for jump lines, or Section Marker; optionally set the section marker text of the page's section

markerText.description: For section_marker: set the marker text of the section the frame's page belongs to (Numbering & Section Options > Section Marker)

place.description: Where to insert: a text frame by id (on a document or parent page) at the start or end of its text, or the text selection / insertion point

at.description: Start or end of the frame's text, or of the selected text

selection.description: Use the text selection or insertion point

name: insert_page_marker
title: Insert Page Marker
